caveat: The photograph shows the parcel's street front; a section draws the face that looks towards the cut, which can be another side of the same building. Taken from the photo: wall material and colour, the base, the roof type, balconies, awnings, shutters, doors. Still schematic: how many openings there are and where they sit.
